cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-wide-tool-switch-keeps-controls-live
cases.purpose: After switching a wide editor from clips to captions, the selected cue's visible delete control remains enabled and sends its exact operation.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-paged-clips-remain-reachable
cases.purpose: Clip pages expose every entry; native activation selects it and selection reveals its page without losing the selected clip on paging.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-empty-project-actions-are-safe
cases.purpose: Missing projects, empty exports, invalid navigation and unavailable playback fail with actionable user errors.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-publish-changes-require-another-preview
cases.purpose: Changing a recipient, text or topic after preview cannot send an unreviewed publication.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-edit-refreshes-form-from-result
cases.purpose: The next trim uses the accepted clip interval rather than stale form fields.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-open-mounts-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening mounts a live runtime with the workbench shell and closing unmounts and kills the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-open-project-lists-clips-and-captions
cases.purpose: Opening a project shows its clips, captions and revision from the CLI in the shell.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-import-files-send-files-and-revision
cases.purpose: Import sends every file name with the current revision and confirmation.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-select-clip-prefills-and-trim-sends-edit
cases.purpose: Selecting a clip prefills the trim form and applying it sends the documented trim operation.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-trim-input-editing-changes-operation
cases.purpose: Typing in the trim field changes the in point of the operation the CLI receives.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-edit-commands-send-exact-operations
cases.purpose: Speed, gain, split, move and remove each send their documented JSON with --revision and --yes.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-undo-and-redo-step-history
cases.purpose: Undo and redo send the history flag with the current revision and confirmation.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-render-preview-starts-a-task
cases.purpose: Preview and screen requests start their background profile; the screen export resumes segments.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-refresh-adopts-completed-preview
cases.purpose: A completed preview render becomes the project's playable preview without mounting a missing file.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-task-panel-lists-tasks-and-cancel
cases.purpose: The tasks pane lists CLI tasks and cancel sends the cancel request with confirmation.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-record-targets-and-toggle-record
cases.purpose: Recording targets come from the CLI and the toggle sends window, audio, duration and confirmation; stop follows.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-publish-preview-then-confirm-with-revision
cases.purpose: Publishing previews silently with target, chat and text, then confirms with the previewed revision and --yes.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-publish-confirm-before-preview-signals
cases.purpose: Confirming without a preview, or after the project changed, signals user-error instead of sending.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-captions-add-update-delete
cases.purpose: Captions can be updated by id, removed and added from the form with final-timeline seconds.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-documented-keys-drive-commands
cases.purpose: The documented pane, refresh, theme, undo and close keys drive the application through the command loop.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-layout-switches-and-keeps-drafts
cases.purpose: Refitting switches narrow and wide layouts and an already typed form draft still reaches the next edit.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-invalid-input-signals-user-error
cases.purpose: Empty titles, missing selections and unparsable numbers signal user-error before any CLI request.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-cli-errors-surface-in-status
cases.purpose: A CLI error object becomes a readable status message instead of a signal.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-missing-executable-reports-deps
cases.purpose: A missing CLI reports deps in the status line and the application still closes cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-state-is-detached-and-theme-toggles
cases.purpose: The reported state is detached plain data and the theme toggles dark to light and back.

cases.name: etaf-video-studio-tests-stage-selected-clip-reports-missing-file
cases.purpose: Selecting a clip whose source file is gone reports it and mounts no decoder.
